title: Web CDK bundling docker cannot write the npm cache
description:
## Found after #339

Deploy Web (development) has failed on every push since `Persist Google sign-in across workspace reload` (#339), including the #339 merge itself.

Last **successful** development web deploy: `4ba8bc2` (#338, spend-ceiling merge). **#339 never reached CloudFront.** Live `dev.chattic.us` is still the #338 bundle. `chatticus-5e4c9a` cannot be concluded against that origin.

Failed run example: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/actions/runs/34285497665

```
npm error syscall mkdir
npm error path /.npm
npm error errno EACCES
...
Your cache folder contains root-owned files...
sudo chown -R 1001:1001 "/.npm"
FailedToBundleAsset ... docker run --rm -u "1001:1001" ... public.ecr.aws/sam/build-nodejs22.x ... npm ci && npm run build --workspace=web
```

The bundling container runs as uid 1001 with HOME effectively `/`, so `npm ci` cannot mkdir `/.npm`. Same class as `chatticus-3935c9` (region/credentials inside this docker), different fault.

#338 could succeed without rebuilding this asset; #339 changed `web/lib/auth.ts` and forced a rebuild.

## Done when

The docker bundle command sets a writable HOME/npm cache for uid 1001; a development web deploy of current `develop` succeeds; `dev.chattic.us` serves the commit that includes #339 (or later). Assert in `infra/` tests. No Gherkin — CDK bundling, not visitor-facing behavior.
